title: Olive and the Pot
note: b414 — Phase 3, sh, th, ng added.

pages.brief: Olive the owl standing inside a wooden potting shed full of plant pots.
Moss the hedgehog digging into dark soil inside a small terracotta pot.
Olive the owl digging into soil inside a second small terracotta pot.
Olive the owl digging into Moss's pot by mistake, soil spilling over the rim.
Moss's terracotta pot with soil spilled messily around it.
Olive the owl looking down with a sad expression beside the messy pot.
Olive the owl digging into a large terracotta pot of her own.
Moss the hedgehog beside his small pot and Olive the owl beside her large pot, both looking content.
